selection_rule: Include every specified current-era net-position key if direct API records supply every one of the706 original Treasury economic dates2013-04-03..2026-10-07 exactly once with finite numeric values. No splicing alternative series, no interpolation, no filling absent dates, no selection by fitted outcomes/volatility/loss. Restrict longer series to this fixed date grid. Preserve all skip reasons and all metadata-era descriptions; same-key definition changes remain a limitation.
download_rule: one direct official request per candidate,45second timeout,1MiB per response cap; any HTTP/schema/availability failure retained as skip. No retries or credentials.
tuning: Each new series/H/W has its own original chronological validation; each method requires every candidate validation to complete. Incomplete menu => whole method cell failed, no partial score or alternate menu. Exact tie => larger lambda for both methods. This common strict panel policy differs from original C2 eligible-subset/first-tie handling; original C2 results unchanged.
interpretation: Additional published aggregate tasks from same reporting system, overlapping asset buckets and dealers; not an independent second dealer nor causal proof of feature transport. No pooled omnibus inference treating series as independent.
